test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'sanitary'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is 'sanitary'.
 
• The word 'sanitary' means '**relating to the conditions that affect hygiene and health, especially the supply of sewage facilities and clean drinking water**'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'sanitary'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the other options.
 
 
• Cultural- *relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.*
 
• **Unhygienic**- *not clean or sanitary.*
 
• Ongoing- *continuing; still in progress*.
